name: A computer made from a recipe
what: A computer starts blank, as a bare macOS or Linux machine, and its recipe says what goes in it. Silo makes the whole working computer from the recipe: a pinned base system, then a layer built by Nix, with an ordinary distribution as the base on Linux so that what agents download runs. Silo keeps the recipe as a property of the computer, not as a folder in one of your repositories.
